en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Hanan Bin Sadeyr, from his father who said,
‘I mentioned the House (Kabah) to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If they were to suspend it for one year, they would not be (given the) Respite (from the Punishment)’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Muhammad ibn Isma‘il from Hanan ibn Sadir from his father who has said the following:
“I once mentioned the House before abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and he said, ‘If people neglect it one year, they will not be given any chance to avoid the coming of torment upon them.’”
